alt: Montana Highway Patrol trooper standing beside a 23-foot bright yellow fiberglass banana-shaped car pulled over on the shoulder of Interstate 90 near Billings
story: Steve Braithwaite's Big Banana Car — a 23-foot fiberglass banana mounted on a 1993 Ford F-150 — was pulled over again on I-90 near Billings, Montana on June 24, 2026 because cargo boxes partially blocked his 'SPLIT' license plate, continuing a 15-year tradition: he says he was 'the most pulled-over man in America' for the first eight years of driving it.
why_funny: He built a vehicle specifically designed to look like a giant banana, expected to drive it legally across America, and is still surprised it keeps attracting police attention — the banana shape physically prevents proper license plate display.
